title: Founding Technical Project Manager
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

On our largest global rollouts, connectivity is what makes or breaks the program.

These customers run several ERP systems across many entities and countries, with interfaces, master data and process variants that have grown over decades. Whether blp is usable on day one, and whether the first go-live holds its date, depends more on getting that landscape right than on almost anything else. You are the person who makes sure it is right. You sit opposite the customer's enterprise architects and IT leads, understand what their landscape actually does rather than what the documentation says, and shape the technical solution with them.

Getting this right is relentless project management as much as architecture. Requirements on a landscape this size never arrive clear. You chase them until they are: pushing the customer's IT organization for answers, going back when an answer is vague, and refusing to let an assumption stand in for a decision. You spot the major developments and the roadblocks early, while there is still time to do something about them, and you put them in front of the Senior Project Manager and into the steering committee rather than discovering them in test.

When you raise something, you bring the way through it. You prepare the discussion with the customer, make the implications clear in their language, and come with options. "We cannot do that and we will miss the go-live" is not the job. Working out what would make it possible, and what it costs, is. Where something exceeds the standard you prepare the decision rather than take it alone: options, effort, consequences, and a clear recommendation for the steering committee or for our engineering leadership.

You are the strong technical counterpart for the customer's IT organization and for the Senior Project Manager. Both rely on you to know what is actually true. You work primarily up to the first go-live, where the solution design is either right or expensive, and you are staffed by process and landscape complexity rather than by deal size.

A word on what you build. Our integration layer works like an iPaaS: connections are assembled as configuration on our own platform, specific to that customer, rather than written as code. You work in that layer yourself, so this is a hands-on role, and you document what you have configured so that the next person can understand and maintain it. What you do not do is write code that ships with the product. That distinction is what keeps a customer-specific solution from quietly becoming everyone's problem.

Two roles sit either side of you and the handoffs are clean.

With the Integrations Engineer: you define what the connection has to do and why, they build and operate it at that customer and own whether it runs. You hand them a specification, they come back with questions and constraints from the real system, and you resolve them together. When something breaks in their environment, it is theirs. When something is wrong in what was asked for, it is yours.

With the Product Engineer: when a requirement cannot be met in configuration, or when the same requirement has now appeared at the third customer, you make the case for building it into the product. You write the specification, they build it, and you are the one who confirms it actually solves the customer problem it came from. After that it is part of the standard and you configure against it like anything else.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the technical solution with the customer, including their enterprise architects and IT leads.

  • Turn business requirements into a clear, implementable specification.

  • Drive requirements to clarity, relentlessly. Chase the customer's IT organization until an answer is specific enough to build on.

  • Configure integrations on our platform where the standard covers it, and document what you have configured.

  • Identify precisely where the standard does not cover a requirement, and judge whether it belongs in configuration or in the product.

  • Identify major development needs and technical roadblocks early, and escalate them to the Senior Project Manager and into the steering committee while there is still time.

  • Prepare those discussions with the customer: make the implications clear, and bring options rather than a refusal.

  • Prepare scope decisions with options, effort and consequences, and bring a clear recommendation to the steering committee or to our engineering leadership.

  • Specify what the Integrations Engineer builds at the customer, and resolve the constraints they bring back from the real system.

  • Make the case for what should be built once for everyone, hand it to our Product Engineers with a proper specification, and confirm it solves the problem it came from.

  • Support the Senior Project Manager and Project Manager on technical feasibility, effort and sequencing.

  • Stay on the account through the first go-live, and hand over a solution design that is documented and maintainable.

  • Feed recurring customer requirements back to Product so the standard grows in the right direction.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Relentless on Clarity – You do not accept a vague answer as an answer, and you keep going until the requirement is specific enough to build on.

  • Architectural Judgment – You can tell the difference between a requirement that deserves a custom solution and one that deserves a conversation.

  • Credibility with Architects – You hold your own with a customer's enterprise architect and earn their trust rather than deferring to them.

  • Clear Recommendations – You frame a difficult scope question so that the people who decide can actually decide, and you say plainly what you would do.

  • Translation – You move between a business requirement and a technical design in both directions without losing anything.

  • Long-Term Thinking – You design for what the customer will need in two years, not only for what unblocks the current wave.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in solution design, technical consulting, enterprise integration or a technical product role.

  • Solid understanding of enterprise system landscapes: ERP systems, interfaces, master data, and how data actually moves between them.

  • Hands-on experience configuring integrations on an integration platform, or comparable low-code or configuration-driven work.

  • Experience writing specifications that engineers can build from without a translation layer.

  • Track record of driving technical clarity in a project setting, including escalating early and constructively.

  • Comfortable in customer-facing technical discussions with senior IT stakeholders.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for hands-on experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or comparable ERP systems, or with e-invoicing and EDI standards.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Hi, ich bin Felix Lippe.

Vor ein paar Jahren habe ich Lippe Personal gegründet. Heute sind wir über 25 Leute und eine der führenden Recruiting-Agenturen für medizinische Praxen in Deutschland: Ärzte, Zahnärzte, Physiotherapeuten, Pflege. Wir haben in den letzten Jahren hunderte Praxen betreut und tausende Bewerbungen für unsere Kunden generiert. Das Geschäft läuft.

Und jetzt kommt der Teil, warum ich diese Stelle ausschreibe.

Ich baue das Unternehmen gerade grundlegend um: weg von manueller Arbeit, hin zu einem KI-gesteuerten Unternehmen. Nicht als Buzzword auf der Website, sondern als echtes Projekt, an dem ich täglich selbst arbeite – mit Tools wie Claude Code, n8n und einem eigenen KI-Setup. Ich tausche mich dazu laufend mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten aus, ich stecke tief im Thema. Was mir fehlt, ist nicht das Wissen und sind nicht die Ideen. Was mir fehlt, ist Zeit und eine rechte Hand, die mit mir baut.

Genau das ist diese Stelle.

Die Rolle: Werkstudent mit Founder-Associate-Charakter

Du arbeitest nicht „bei uns in der IT". Du arbeitest mit mir. Direkt, auf Geschäftsführer-Ebene, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Konkret heißt das: Wir schauen uns gemeinsam an, wo im Unternehmen noch manuell gearbeitet wird, und dann bauen wir das weg. Du bekommst von mir klare Briefings, setzt eigenständig um, und wir sprechen uns in einem festen wöchentlichen Termin ab – oft auch öfter, weil ich Sparring liebe. Du bist bei strategischen Themen dabei, verstehst, warum wir Dinge tun, und siehst, wie ein Unternehmen von innen umgebaut wird. Wenn ich mich mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten austausche, bekommst du das mit und lernst direkt daraus – genau wie ich.

Das ist der Deal: Du hebelst meine Zeit, ich gebe dir Einblicke und Verantwortung, die du als Werkstudent sonst nirgendwo bekommst.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust mit KI-Tools (vor allem Claude Code) Automatisierungen für unser Tagesgeschäft: Bewerbermanagement, Reporting, Anzeigenerstellung

  • Du optimierst, automatisierst und digitalisierst Prozesse quer durchs Unternehmen – vom Vertrieb bis zum Fulfillment

  • Du setzt Workflows in n8n auf und verbindest unsere Tools miteinander (Airtable, HubSpot, GitHub)

  • Du dokumentierst, was du baust, so dass es als System im Unternehmen bleibt und wächst

  • Du bist mein Sparringspartner: Wir entwickeln gemeinsam weiter, wie dieses Unternehmen in zwei Jahren arbeitet

Was ich dir biete

  • 20 Euro pro Stunde – bewusst am oberen Ende für Werkstudenten in Düsseldorf, weil ich lieber einen richtig Guten habe als drei Mittelmäßige

  • 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel um deinen Vorlesungsplan herum, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr

  • Nach der Einarbeitung weitgehend Homeoffice. Unser Office in Düsseldorf steht dir jederzeit offen

  • Professionelles KI-Setup ab Tag eins (u. a. Claude Code Max Plan) – du arbeitest mit Tools, die die meisten Unternehmen noch nicht mal kennen

  • Direkter Zugang zu allem, was ich lerne: aus dem Austausch mit KI-Agenturen, Experten und aus unseren eigenen Projekten

  • Echte Verantwortung statt Praktikanten-Aufgaben: Was du baust, läuft danach jeden Tag in einem echten Unternehmen

  • Eine Erfahrung, die dich von praktisch jedem Absolventen abhebt: Du hast nicht über digitale Transformation gelesen, du hast eine mitgebaut

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

Bitte kein klassisches Anschreiben, das liest hier keiner. Stattdessen:

  1. Bewerbung über das Formular – Lebenslauf plus (das ist mir am wichtigsten) ein Link zu irgendetwas, das du gebaut hast: GitHub-Repo, kleines Tool, Automatisierung, Uni-Projekt. Größe egal. Dazu zwei, drei Sätze, was du zuletzt mit KI gelöst hast

  2. Probeaufgabe – wenn deine Bewerbung passt, bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe (zwei bis drei Stunden Aufwand)

  3. 30-Minuten-Call mit mir – wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen

  4. Entscheidung innerhalb von 48 Stunden. Versprochen

Ich freue mich auf dich.

Felix Lippe
Geschäftsführer, Lippe Personal GmbH


Dein Profil

Ich halte das bewusst offen, weil mir deine Denkweise wichtiger ist als dein Lebenslauf:

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Vollzeit-Student, zum Beispiel in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder etwas Vergleichbarem. Auch andere Studiengänge sind okay, wenn du technisch unterwegs bist

  • Du hast schon mal mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor oder ChatGPT etwas Eigenes gebaut oder automatisiert. Muss nichts Großes sein, aber du solltest es zeigen können

  • Begriffe wie Git und Terminal schrecken dich nicht ab

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du fragst nicht „was soll ich tun?", sondern „was bringt uns weiter?"

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst niemanden, der dir dreimal am Tag über die Schulter schaut

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

Falls du denkst „ich habe noch nie professionell programmiert": völlig okay. Ich suche keinen fertigen Entwickler. Ich suche jemanden, der mit KI-Tools umgehen kann, Prozesse versteht und Lust hat, mit einem Gründer ein Unternehmen umzubauen. Das ist ein eigenes Handwerk – und ehrlich gesagt eines der wertvollsten, die man 2026 lernen kann.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (f/m/x)
description:
Your role with us

As Senior Platform Engineer, you own the platform that Workist's AI agents run on: two clouds, the Kubernetes clusters for production, staging and ML workloads, and the path from merge request to production for every service we ship. You decide how this platform evolves, you keep it secure, observable and cost-efficient, and you extend it as the product grows. Most recently that meant an LLM gateway with region failover in front of our Azure OpenAI deployments, and performing GPU capacity planning for our own models.

You set your own roadmap. Infrastructure at Workist is run as quarterly themes that you propose, make the case for and deliver, and roughly a third of your time goes to whatever the week brings: an incident, a pentest finding, a developer whose deployment is stuck and needs a second pair of eyes. You report to our CTO and are the voice of the platform in engineering decisions.


How we build and run things

  • Everything runs on Kubernetes (Azure AKS), deployed with Helm and GitOps/Flux. All infrastructure is Terraform, applied through CI.

  • CI/CD for every service on GitLab

  • Managed services wherever they keep life simple: Postgres, OpenSearch, Redis, blob storage. We self-host only where it clearly pays off.

  • Two clouds: Azure as our primary cloud, AWS for search and mail ingestion.

  • Python everywhere: read and fix application code when that is where the fix belongs.

  • Security is routine: automated scanning in every pipeline, regular external pentests, quarterly backup and disaster-recovery tests.


Your responsibilities

Own the platform

  • Own the architecture of our cloud environments across Azure and AWS: how subscriptions, networks, identities and environments are structured and stay isolated

  • Design and deliver the platform capabilities the product needs next, from GPU capacity and an LLM gateway to new environments

  • Set the standard for how we run Kubernetes and our managed data services: capacity planned ahead of growth, changes and upgrades rolled out safely and routinely, costs kept in check

Keep it quiet

  • Own the security posture end to end: least-privilege access, network isolation, findings from scanners and pentests, and a patch cadence that runs itself. Be a technical counterpart for audits and security questionnaires

  • Own observability and alerting so that every alert is worth acting on, and lead the response to platform incidents including the follow-up fixes

  • Run quarterly backup/restore and disaster-recovery tests, and close what they reveal

Make the team faster

  • Own the path from merge request to production: fast builds, reliable deployments, environments and access on demand

  • Build the infrastructure behind our AI models: the LLM gateway, model deployments with region failover, GPU capacity, and whatever the next model needs

title: Sales Development Senior Manager
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Sales Development Senior Manager to join our Sales team in Berlin! 

This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our office.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Act as the direct leader and mentor for our front-line Business Development Representative (BDR) team, fostering a culture of growth and purpose.
  • Conduct live call-shadowing and deep-dive reviews to sharpen your team's ability to communicate the transformative power of Wellhub.
  • Take full accountability for a team of 5–8 BDRs, guiding their professional journey and ensuring they hit the milestones that drive our mission forward.
  • Lead the interview process for new talent and execute a seamless onboarding program that gets new starters hitting "active" status within 30 days.
  • Excellence in building strong partnerships with marketing and sales.
  • Deeply understand the UK B2B ecosystem to teach your team how to position wellbeing as a "business-critical" priority for CHROs and CFOs.
  • Pivot messaging based on market shifts to ensure Wellhub remains a vital solution for companies navigating industry headwinds.
  • Manage the "speed-to-lead" for inbound inquiries, ensuring high conversion rates through rigorous qualification.
  • Work with the team to build hyper-personalised outbound "clusters." You'll move beyond generic sequences to high-intent, research-backed prospecting.
  • Ensure the team is getting maximum ROI out of Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and AI-assisted prospecting tools.
  • Develop the best-in-class strategies for managing the rep's book of business and running the outreach-prospecting playbook and turning curiosity into attention with intention.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Proven Track Record: 5+ years in Sales, with at least 1-2 years of experience as a Lead BDR or Front-line Manager.
  • The "Coach" DNA: A passion for seeing others succeed.
  • You can look at a conversion funnel and pinpoint exactly where the "leak" is-whether it's the initial hook, the discovery call, or the hand-off to the AE.
  • Proven experience managing SDR/BDR teams for a Challenger Brand or a "non-commodity" solution.
  • You must demonstrate the ability to create urgency for a product that is not yet a "household name" or is perceived as discretionary spend.
  • You have moved beyond "feature-selling" and can coach reps to pivot from Product Interest to Business Impact.
  • You should be able to show how you've successfully positioned a solution as "mission-critical" during budget-conscious cycles.
  • You are familiar with the HR space and can talk the CHRO language.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. 

 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. 

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role is Hybrid, with a minimum of 2 days per week in-office. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

title: Senior Partner
description:
About the Role

This is a founding partner opportunity at an AI-native law firm operating in Germany, built on a proprietary agentic platform that automates recurring legal work. You will serve as the firm's primary market-facing rainmaker, bringing an established book of business and helping shape the firm's early growth trajectory. The role sits at the intersection of law, business development, and legal technology, and carries meaningful equity participation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring your portable client book onto the firm's AI agent platform and continue serving your existing clients.

  • Act as the primary market-facing presence, opening top-of-funnel opportunities through your PE/VC and mid-market network.

  • Cross-sell commercial and compliance services into your existing client base.

  • Work with the founding team to migrate recurring matters onto the automation platform.

  • Help drive the firm's growth from its current client base toward its next funding milestone.

What We're Looking For

  • 12 to 20+ years of experience in legal practice in Germany.

  • German-qualified attorney (Volljurist) admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with a Dr. iur. or LL.M. preferred.

  • Experience at a ranked German law firm or boutique of equivalent standing, at equity or salaried partner level.

  • A personally portable book of business of €1M or more, with clients who follow the attorney rather than the firm brand.

  • Strong network into private equity, venture capital, or mid-market companies that unlocks cross-sell into commercial and compliance work.

  • A diversified client base across multiple sectors, including recurring and automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate/VC, or regulatory matters.

  • Native-level German and professional English.

  • Germany-based and fully work-authorized, with a feasible client migration path within approximately six months and no restrictive non-competes.

  • Genuine conviction in the AI-native law firm model and hands-on experience using AI tools such as large language models or legal AI products in daily practice.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range is €200,000 to €300,000 per year, plus meaningful equity in the firm. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

This is a hybrid role based in Berlin, Germany.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About the Role

This is a technical pre-sales role at a Series A AI-powered R&D platform company serving enterprise customers in chemicals, materials science, pharma, and adjacent industries. You will be the primary technical voice in the sales process, partnering with Account Executives to demonstrate platform value, run pilots, and close net new revenue. The role sits at the intersection of deep scientific expertise and customer-facing storytelling.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full technical pre-sales cycle, from initial demo through business value case development, technical evaluation, and pilot execution.

  • Architect and build custom demonstrations, workshops, and pilots tailored to each prospect's R&D workflows.

  • Lead demo sessions and technical evaluations, crafting compelling narratives around R&D data management and innovation acceleration.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and champion stakeholders to drive value-based selling.

  • Write scripts and configure integrations on the platform's integration server to support custom prospect engagements.

  • Mentor and manage new graduate team members who support technical evaluations.

  • Travel 25 to 50% to deliver on-site presentations and workshops with prospects.

What We're Looking For

  • MS or PhD in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a related field with an ML or computational focus; advanced degree strongly preferred.

  • 4 to 7 years of experience in a relevant role, such as technical pre-sales, R&D digitalization, management consulting with a science background, or software engineering.

  • Demonstrated experience leading digitalization or change management initiatives in an industrial or enterprise R&D environment.

  • Proven track record building and demoing technical platforms to enterprise customers.

  • Scripting ability in Python and comfort configuring integrations and automations.

  • Familiarity with enterprise R&D workflows, laboratory informatics systems, or ELN platforms.

  • Strong domain knowledge in chemistry, materials science, or chemical engineering.

  • Excellent communication skills in English; C1 or higher proficiency in German or the relevant local language required for EU-based candidates.

  • Authorized to work in the role's country without visa sponsorship.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Munich, New York, or London.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary range: $100,000 to $150,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Location

This role is fully remote, with primary location in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. Candidates in New York, NY (USA) or London, UK are also considered. Regular travel of 25 to 50% is expected.

title: Implementation Manager (Payments/Billing experience preferred) (f/m/d)
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

  • Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Agile delivery experience 

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Fluent English + German

  • Previous experience in payments is nice to have for this position

✨ As our Client Delivery Lead, you’ll be driving success and leading projects directly as a key individual contributor, without direct line management responsibilities.

description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change.

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. title: Langfuse - Product Engineer, Integrations
description:
Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse

Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands.

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations.

You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development.

The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

Everything you build is open source and immediately visible.

All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it.

  • Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience.

  • Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations.

  • Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes.

  • Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For

  • Passionate about the LLM ecosystem. You’ve built real applications with frameworks like LangChain, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, or similar — or you have a deep willingness to go deep and get your hands dirty with every major framework in the space. You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it.

  • Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems.

  • Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work?

  • Self-directed and motivated. You know how to develop conviction about what to build and how to ship it. You don’t wait for detailed specs — you investigate the framework, talk to users, and propose the right approach.

  • Excited about open source and developer community. You genuinely enjoy talking to developers about their integration challenges, writing clear documentation, and contributing to open source projects.

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team. Your output is visible and matters. You’re comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks.

CS or quantitative degree preferred, but not required. We care far more about what you’ve built and your hunger to learn.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation

  • Contributions to popular open source projects, SDKs, or developer tools

  • Experience building developer tooling, CLIs, or client libraries

  • Former founder or early startup experience

  • Active presence in AI/ML developer communities (blog posts, talks, open source)

 

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

Projects You Could Own

  • Build and ship a Langfuse integration for an emerging agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, new OTEL-based instrumentation)

  • Design the integration pattern for a new category of AI tools (e.g., voice agents via LiveKit/Pipecat)

  • Create comprehensive quickstart cookbooks that get developers from zero to traced in under 5 minutes

  • Work with the OpenTelemetry community to improve GenAI semantic conventions

  • Maintain and upgrade our most popular integrations (OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) as those frameworks ship breaking changes

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Senior DevOps Engineer - Remote UK
description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

At Deliveroo we have an outstanding data science organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making. We work throughout the company - in product, business and platform teams - using analysis, experimentation, causal inference and machine learning techniques. We are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Deliveroo.

Data Scientists at Deliveroo report into our data science management team, and we have a highly active data science community, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes, a robust technical review process, and plenty of opportunities to learn new things. Data Scientists can equally progress as technical leads (individual contributors) and as people managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not. We celebrate difference and have a dedicated data science diversity committee.

  • Which markets/cities should we enter next?

  • How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?

  • What is the business impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants?

  • Can the Delivery food market sustain multiple players?

  • What are the trade-offs we face when choosing between growth and profitability? How should we decide between them?

  • What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants?

  • What impact do online reviews have?

  • How will a change in the user interface affect customer choice behaviour?

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business-relevant economic problems

  • A critical thinker with very strong attention to detail

  • Proficiency with analytical tools like R/Python and familiarity with SQL

  • Ideally industry experience since the completion of your academic career

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. title: Senior Privacy Counsel

OUR MISSION

In the last couple of years we have gone big and acquired both Carwow Leasey, a leasing broker, and Autovia, creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach of over 350 million. We also launched our successful Sell My Car business in Germany. We are continually driving to make Carwow the go-to destination for people looking to change their car.

And we’re a long way from done!

LEGAL & COMPLIANCE @ CARWOW

Our fantastic legal team has been compared to a set of high-performance tyres, enabling Carwow to drive and corner at high speeds whilst keeping Carwow firmly on the road in all conditions. As the business pushes forward with bold ambitions, the legal team’s purpose is clear: to drive Carwow’s growth with integrity and confidence – and that’s where you come in!

YOUR MISSION

We are a platform that sits right in the middle between consumers and OEMs/Dealers in the car-changing journey. Datasits at the heart of everything we do and we want to commercialise it responsibly.

As Senior Privacy Counsel, you will be Carwow’s dedicated in-house privacy lawyer and operational privacy lead, playing a pivotal role in enabling the business to grow and scale at pace with integrity. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a complex, high-growth and data-thirsty marketplace business.

We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel who wants to do more than provide legal advice from the sidelines. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing legal function as our first dedicated in-house privacy hire, taking ownership of the day-to-day privacy programme while acting as a senior legal and strategic advisor to the business as it sharpens its privacy governance programme and steers towards further growth and an exit.

We are not at “Day Zero”. We currently have an external DPO, established policies, templates, a RoPA and a risk register.

We need a tech-fluent privacy lawyer who is equally comfortable advising and doing: someone who can interpret complex legal requirements, exercise sound legal judgement and provide pragmatic advice, but who will also roll up their sleeves and build, operate and continuously improve the mechanisms that make privacy work in practice.

You will have the mandate to lift the lid on our technology stack, validate our data flows, identify legal and operational privacy risks and work directly with our Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and commercial teams to keep the business safe and moving fast.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Privacy governance and framework development: Own, develop and maintain Carwow’s enterprise privacy governance framework, encompassing internal policies, ROPAs, privacy notices, risk registers, retention schedules and associated controls. Interpret applicable legal requirements and ensure our documentation and processes reflect the reality of Carwow’s technology stack and processing activities, leading remediation where discrepancies or risks are identified.

  • Legal advice and business partnering: Act as Carwow’s principal in-house legal advisor on privacy and data protection matters. Develop strong business partnering relationships across Marketing, Media, Product, Engineering, Data and other parts of the business, providing pragmatic, risk-based legal advice that enables commercial objectives while appropriately managing privacy risk. Provide advice to senior management and support the General Counsel in updating the Company’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives as needed.

  • Culture & Training: Build a strong internal perception of privacy as a “trust builder”. Design and deliver role-specific training that is engaging, commercially relevant and free of unnecessary legal jargon, helping teams understand both their legal obligations and how to apply them in practice.

  • Breach response: Lead the privacy aspects of data breach and incident response, working cross-functionally to investigate incidents, assess legal and regulatory risk, determine notification obligations and oversee remediation. Liaise with the external DPO, regulators and other relevant stakeholders as appropriate.

  • DPAs, DSAs and data contracting: Draft, review and negotiate DPAs, DSAs and other data protection provisions and agreements arising from commercial arrangements. Provide practical legal advice on controller/processor relationships, data sharing, international transfers and related privacy risks.

  • DSARs and individual rights: Own and continuously improve Carwow’s processes for responding to data subject rights requests, ensuring requests can be handled lawfully, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the business. Provide legal guidance on complex or sensitive requests where required.

  • Retail Media and Ad Tech: Provide legal and operational privacy support on new commercial propositions looking to leverage Carwow’s data for third-party audience targeting, segmentation and advertising. Advise on the appropriate use of personal data, profiling, consent and data-sharing structures and help design commercially workable and legally robust mechanisms for using and sharing data.

  • Product, Data and Technology: Work closely with Data & Insights, IT, Engineering and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle to embed Privacy by Design. Lead or support privacy assessments, identify legal and operational risks in new products and processing activities, and translate complex technical data flows into clear, risk-based advice for the General Counsel, Executives and wider business.

  • Operationalise Compliance: Own and operate core privacy compliance processes, including DPIAs, LIAs and data-sharing assessments. Look continuously for opportunities to integrate these into existing business workflows, with an eye on making compliance proportionate, scalable and automated wherever possible.

  • Regulatory developments: Monitor and interpret relevant developments in privacy, data protection, digital regulation and related areas, assess their impact on Carwow and translate new legal requirements into practical changes to products, policies, controls and business processes.

  • Corporate work: Provide privacy legal support on M&A, funding and other corporate transactions, including conducting privacy due diligence, identifying material risks and supporting remediation and integration activity.

  • AI and emerging technology: Advise on the privacy implications of AI and emerging technologies adopted or developed across the business, while supporting the development of practical governance mechanisms that allow Carwow to innovate responsibly.

  • Multi-jurisdictional: Support Carwow’s businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal, advising on relevant local and European privacy requirements and working with external counsel where specialist local advice is required.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A qualified lawyer, admitted to practise in England & Wales or another relevant UK or European jurisdiction, with significant experience advising on privacy and data protection matters.

  • Significant experience working in-house, balancing legal and regulatory requirements with commercial objectives and operating as a trusted advisor to the business.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK and European data protection law, with the ability to interpret legislation, regulatory guidance and emerging issues and translate them into clear, practical and commercially workable advice.

  • Experience not only providing privacy legal advice but also building, operating or materially contributing to a privacy programme, including areas such as DPIAs, RoPAs, privacy notices, data rights, retention, incident response and privacy governance.

  • The ability and willingness to work autonomously as Carwow’s principal in-house privacy specialist, moving comfortably between complex legal analysis and hands-on operational delivery.

  • Passionate about the intersection of AI and privacy, with an interest in how to safeguard the organisation during technology adoption while also leveraging AI to enhance and automate privacy operations.

  • A team player with a growth mindset, high EQ and low ego, excited to be part of a scale-up, high-growth company where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.

  • To be able to work in a fast-paced environment with teams that move and pivot quickly.

  • Fluency in English and strong written and verbal communication skills, together with a proactive, persuasive and adaptable manner.

  • Driven to ensure the Legal & Compliance Team is viewed as a genuine partner to the business, with the initiative and credibility to build relationships across functions and at senior levels.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • A track record of working effectively with all levels of an organisation, including senior management and executives.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience in Mar-Tech or Ad-Tech.

  • Experience advising on AI governance or wider digital regulation.

  • Experience supporting organisations operating across multiple European jurisdictions.

  • A CIPP/E and/or CIPM qualification from the IAPP, or equivalent demonstrable privacy expertise.

About Neko Health

Neko Health is a Swedish healthcare technology company founded in 2018 by Hjalmar Nilsonne and Daniel Ek. Our mission is to redesign healthcare by shifting the focus from reactive treatment to proactive and preventive care.

We are building a new kind of healthcare experience designed to help people stay ahead of their health. By combining medical expertise with breakthrough technology, we make it possible to quickly and non-invasively gather a broad picture of a person's health and deliver clear insights within minutes.

Headquartered in Stockholm and New York, Neko Health offers the Neko Body Scan experience across Europe and the US, supported by a growing team of people working to transform how healthcare is delivered.

Why this role exists

Legal, Finance and People are what let Neko operate, hire and stay compliant as it scales, and Product & Technology is the largest, most complex function at HQ. These aren't the same kind of problem. Each function sits at a different stage of maturity, and this role isn't about pulling them into one shape. It's about moving fluidly between genuinely different disciplines, bringing the right kind of people practice to each, rather than defaulting to a single playbook.

This is one of the most senior People roles at HQ outside the Global People Lead itself. It suits a senior level HR operator who's genuinely comfortable holding several different kinds of problem at once, and who brings real depth in organisational design, workforce planning, strategy and culture, genuine command of each rather than surface-level familiarity.

What you'll do

Own the people agenda across Corporate Functions and partners with the Global People lead on parts of the Product & Tech organisation

  • Lead workforce planning and organisational design across Legal, Finance, People, (and support to parts of the Product & Technology teams) role clarity, resourcing decisions and structural recommendations tailored to each function's stage

  • Meet each function on its own terms, building where a function is still finding its shape, optimising where it's stable, rather than applying one approach everywhere

  • Build genuine partnership with the leaders who run each of these teams, calibrating the relationship to what each one needs

Be the strategic partner to senior leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner across Legal, Finance, People and some of the Product & Technology teams, translating business strategy into people priorities, programmes and operating plans for each function

  • Coach and challenge leaders on the decisions that shape the organisation they'll be running next year, thinking a step ahead of today's priorities

  • Bring sound judgement and discretion to the most sensitive people matters across all four functions

Champion Neko's culture and Vitals

  • Partner with leaders across Legal, Finance, People and parts of the Product & Technology to embed Neko's cultural Vitals into how their teams actually operate, day to day

  • Help leaders translate the Vitals into practical behaviours and decisions across genuinely different functions

  • Build the rituals and feedback loops that keep culture genuinely lived as each function matures at its own pace

Drive talent management across Corporate Functions and Product & Tech

  • Working in partnership with the Growth & Engagement team to drive leadership development, performance and engagement for the leadership population across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology

  • Advise on compensation, mobility and promotions in partnership with Reward & Enablement, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness across genuinely different functions

Lead change and manage risk

  • Lead and sponsor change initiatives that affect structure or operating model in any of these functions, owning scope, timeline, stakeholder engagement and change readiness from start to finish

  • Manage employee relations matters across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology, working directly with Legal colleagues and specialist counsel to resolve issues with discretion and confidentiality

  • Spot risk early, whether that's capacity strain in Legal or Finance, or Product & Technology's pace outstripping its structure

Drive organisational design and workforce planning

  • Use workforce and org data to shape decisions ahead of need

  • Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that turn data into clear, decision-ready recommendations

  • Put data and AI to work in how the people agenda runs day to day, sharper decisions, less manual effort

Bring the right practice to functions at different stages

  • Recognise that Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology each need different structures, rhythms and support, and build accordingly

  • Turn central People programmes into practice that fits each function's actual culture and maturity

  • Experience evaluating how AI informs talent decisions and org design, bringing the judgement to design with AI as a genuine participant in how roles and structures should look, actively shaping the work itself.

What you bring

  • Deep, hands-on experience across organisational design, workforce planning, people strategy and culture, genuine depth in all four, built through direct ownership rather than generalist HRBP exposure

  • 10+ years in senior HR Business Partner, People Partner, or People/HR leadership roles, including ownership of the people agenda across genuinely different functions at Director level or above

  • Experience owning leadership development and performance calibration outcomes for a senior leadership population

  • A track record of personally leading change initiatives end to end: scope, timeline, and stakeholder engagement

  • A genuine passion for culture and values, with experience helping leaders embed them into how their teams actually work

  • Working knowledge of employment law relevant to Neko's HQ locations, with the judgement to know when to bring in specialist expertise

description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

Role Purpose

We’re looking for an experienced Ultrasound sonographer to join our multidisciplinary team in London on a 12 month fixed term contract and help to take ultrasounds as part of a clinical research study.

This is a key role focused on delivering high-quality, independent assessments. You’ll perform and interpret ultrasound scans of adult women who are receiving a breast ultrasound as part of a clinical study. You will work in conjunction with the principal investigator of the study to ensure that assessments and reports are of research-grade quality. This is a fixed term role that lasts for the duration of the study and is based at our clinics in London.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Perform high-quality diagnostic ultrasound examinations in line with clinical guidelines and best practices with focus on breast ultrasound

  • Pass on the study-specific acquisition and interpretation qualification task before performing study scans, with certificate filed in the investigational site file.

  • Independently interpret and report ultrasound findings, ensuring timely delivery of results that are uploaded to a standardised electronic case report form.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary research team to help deliver Neko’s clinical trial focused on better understanding risks of breast cancer.

  • Adherence to the study acquisition SOP

  • Equipment QA maintenance logged on-site. Liaise directly with the study PI and research team where needed.

Minimum Requirements

  • HCPC-registered diagnostic radiographer (or other HCPC-/NMC-registered healthcare professional), holding a CASE-accredited postgraduate qualification in breast ultrasound (PgCert / PgDip / MSc, or a named CASE-accredited breast ultrasound module.

  • Documented, current breast ultrasound practice, with a minimum of two years’ full-time-equivalent breast scanning.

  • Advanced radiographic experience of reporting autonomously within the NHS Breast Screening Programme (NHSBSP) or an equivalent quality-assurance framework.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to study participants.

  • Commitment to maintaining high clinical standards and engaging in ongoing professional development.

Preferred

  • Experience with previous ultrasound scanning as part of clinical trials

  • Experience with shear-wave elastography acquisition and reporting.

  • Experience with Philips US machines, and decision support software

  • Familiarity with data entry as part of clinical research studies.
