title: Lead Product Manager
description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams.

Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps.

As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office.

What You'll Own

AI-native product experiences

  • Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development.

  • Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users.

  • Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction.

Prescription and eligibility

  • Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost.

  • Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild.

  • Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge.

Recommendation, commitment and finalisation

  • Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting.

  • Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap.

  • Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start.

  • Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel.

Metrics and experimentation

  • Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails.

  • Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable.

  • Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points.

  • Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch.

  • Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context. You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner.

Must-have experience:

  • Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation).

  • Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards.

  • Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments.

  • Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies.

  • Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts.

  • Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content.

  • AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies.

Strong signals we look for:

  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context.

  • Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic.

  • Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users.

  • A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise.

  • A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus.

How you work:

  • Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities.

  • Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good.

  • Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces.

  • AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work.

Not for you if:

This role won't fit if you'd rather write specs than stay close to the data, the design, and the customer. It also won't fit if you see AI as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a product team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on a product that genuinely changes economic trajectories.

  • A team that takes craft seriously and holds a high bar.

  • Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over product direction.

  • A place in a company rebuilding itself as product-powered and AI-native, where you help define the result rather than inherit it.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Create dashboards and visualisations for application performance that proactively identify and address potential problems before they occur.

We include you

title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

 

Your Team and Role

As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow.

 

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/

 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands

  • Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems

  • Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects

  • Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on

  • A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft

  • Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system

  • Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms

  • Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales

  • Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality

  • Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale

  • Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics

  • Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

En tant que Business Development Representative chez Amenitiz, vous prenez en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact de prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste centré uniquement sur la prise de rendez-vous. Vous prospectez, réalisez des démonstrations, traitez les objections et concluez les ventes, tout en gérant votre pipeline et votre contribution au chiffre d'affaires de bout en bout.

Nos clients sont des hôteliers indépendants partout en Europe : des établissements familiaux, des hôtels-boutiques et de petites chaînes hôtelières insuffisamment servis par des solutions technologiques conçues pour les grands groupes. Avec plus de 15 000 clients et une note de satisfaction de 4,8/5, notre produit bénéficie d'une forte reconnaissance sur le marché.

Vous commercialiserez une solution qui a un impact concret et mesurable sur le quotidien de ses utilisateurs, tout en étant pleinement responsable de l'ensemble du processus qui leur permet d'y accéder.

(Ce rôle est basé à Lyon, en France)

Votre mission

  • Prospection et génération de pipeline

  • Identifiez et contactez de nouveaux clients potentiels par téléphone, e-mail et chat. Maintenez un niveau d'activité élevé et construisez un pipeline commercial solide à partir de zéro. Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble de votre activité de prospection.

  • Découverte des besoins et qualification

  • Comprenez l'organisation actuelle de chaque prospect, ses problématiques et ses besoins opérationnels. Identifiez rapidement les opportunités pertinentes et positionnez Amenitiz de manière précise et adaptée à leur situation.

  • Démonstrations produit

  • Animez des démonstrations structurées et personnalisées qui établissent un lien direct entre les fonctionnalités du produit et les enjeux métier du prospect. Rendez la prise de décision simple et évidente.

  • Gestion des objections et closing

  • Traitez avec assurance les hésitations, les comparaisons avec la concurrence et les objections liées au timing. Créez un sentiment d'urgence lorsque cela est pertinent et sachez demander la signature.

  • Gestion du pipeline

  • Maintenez HubSpot à jour et garantissez la fiabilité des données. Réalisez des prévisions précises et assurez un suivi rigoureux de chaque opportunité.

  • Collaboration

  • Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables commerciaux et vos collègues afin d'améliorer en continu votre approche. Partagez les retours du marché, les objections récurrentes et les informations concurrentielles pour contribuer à la performance collective.

À propos de vous

  • Vous disposez de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience dans une fonction commerciale (SDR, Account Executive ou poste en cycle de vente complet).

  • Vous êtes de langue maternelle française, italienne, espagnole ou portugaise, et possédez un excellent niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour alterner entre des phases de prospection intensive et des phases de closing au cours d'une même semaine.

  • Vous assumez l'entière responsabilité de votre pipeline et de vos résultats, au-delà des simples indicateurs d'activité.

  • Vous adoptez une approche structurée de la gestion commerciale : vos prévisions sont fiables et votre suivi est irréprochable.

  • Vous faites preuve de résilience et de régularité dans un environnement exigeant, orienté objectifs et à fort volume d'activité.

  • Une expérience en SaaS, dans la technologie appliquée à l'hôtellerie ou en startup constitue un atout.
    La maîtrise de HubSpot ou d'un CRM similaire est appréciée.


Ce que nous offrons

  • Une rémunération attractive (OTE) composée d'un salaire fixe et de commissions déplafonnées basées sur la performance.

  • Des stock-options avec un calendrier d'acquisition progressif.

  • Une couverture santé complète.

  • Un accès anticipé à votre salaire, sans attendre la fin du mois.

  • Un parcours de carrière structuré, avec des critères d'évolution clairement définis à chaque niveau.

  • Des avantages flexibles permettant d'optimiser vos dépenses liées aux repas, à la garde d'enfants, aux transports et à la formation.

  • L'achat de tout livre professionnel dont vous avez besoin, ainsi qu'un accès à une bibliothèque partagée au sein de l'équipe.

  • Une équipe internationale composée de plus de 35 nationalités, basée dans l'un des principaux hubs technologiques européens.

title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.


Your responsibilities

  • Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

Tools we use

  • Amplitude, SQL, Looker

  • Figma

  • Notion

  • Slack

  • Enterpret

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

  • Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

  • Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

  • First interview with Sacha, our CEO

  • Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

  • Cultural fit assessments

  • And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

title: Category Manager ( CDD de remplacement temporaire )
description:
Le groupe Lovehoney est le leader mondial du bien-être sexuel. Sa mission est d’améliorer le plaisir grâce à des technologies innovantes et à une approche fondée sur les données, tout en favorisant des perspectives créatives et originales sur l’intimité. Nous proposons des marques passionnantes avec des sextoys, de la lingerie et des accessoires innovants et de haute qualité, le tout dans le cadre d’une expérience d’achat en ligne simplifiée.

Chez Lovehoney, nous employons plus de 800 personnes passionnées et avant-gardistes réparties dans 9 bureaux à travers le monde, chacune apportant un mélange unique de talents à notre effectif diversifié. Nous sommes fiers d’être une entreprise qui prospère en faisant les choses différemment, en remettant en question les attentes et les stéréotypes tout en ayant un impact positif sur la vie de nos clients.

Rejoignez-nous chez Lovehoney, où le plaisir s’allie à la créativité, aux données et à l’innovation !


Missions et Responsabilités

Nous recherchons, dans le cadre d'un CDD de remplacement temporaire,  un/e Category Manager  pour rejoindre notre équipe et prendre en charge la qualité, l’enrichissement et la performance de nos fiches produits sur nos deux sites e-commerce : espaceplaisir et SexyAvenue.

Vous n'êtes pas simplement en charge des fiches produit : vous êtes celui ou celle qui garantit que chaque produit est complet, bien présenté et connecté aux bons produits complémentaires sur Magento. Vous êtes garant(e) de la qualité des données produit, de la pertinence des associations cross-sell et de l'impact éditorial des fiches produit sur l'ensemble des sites (espaceplaisir, SexyAvenue), avec un objectif clair : maximiser la conversion et le panier moyen. 

Vos missions: 

1. Gestion des fiches produit sur Magento 

→  Créer, enrichir et maintenir les fiches produit sur Magento (catégorisation, attributs, stock, visuels, prix) 

→  Garantir la qualité et l'exhaustivité des données produit sur l'ensemble du catalogue (espaceplaisir, SexyAvenue) 

→  Assurer la mise en ligne des nouveautés et le suivi du cycle de vie produit (lancement, réassort, fin de vie), en veillant à ce que chaque nouveauté soit systématiquement poussée dans les bonnes catégories dès sa mise en ligne 

→  Décliner les produits configurables et les produits simples, et effectuer les rattachements adéquats 

→  Mettre à jour les anciennes fiches produit (adapter les visuels, le ton de marque, les recommandations SEO, etc.) 

2. Copywriting & contenus produit 

→  Rédiger et optimiser les fiches produit avec une véritable dimension éditoriale (titres, descriptions, argumentaires) 

→  Rédiger des points forts produit très catchy et marketing, capables de capter l'attention et de donner envie 

→  Adapter le ton de marque propre à chaque site (espaceplaisir et SexyAvenue conservent des discours volontairement différenciés) 

→  Rédiger les contenus catégories et les FAQ produits, en lien avec le SEO Manager 

→  Ajouter des vidéos sur les fiches produit pour enrichir l'expérience client 

→  Faire les demandes aux graphistes pour les contenus manquants côté groupe et/ou à adapter pour le marché français 

→  Intégrer les recommandations SEO (mots-clés, structure) directement dans la rédaction des fiches produit 

3. Cross-sell & merchandising produit 

→  Définir et paramétrer les associations de cross-sell et d'upsell sur les fiches produit 

→  Mettre en place des sélections de produits complémentaires pour maximiser le panier moyen 

→  Remplir l'ensemble des main catégories et veiller à la cohérence du fil d'Ariane et de l'arborescence du site 

→  Analyser la performance des cross-sell et ajuster les recommandations produit 

→  Collaborer avec l'E-Merchandising Manager sur le tri et la mise en avant des produits associés 

 


Profil recherché

Compétences techniques 

→  Maîtrise de Magento 2 (thème Hyvä) ou autre CMS — compétence indispensable 

→  Excellente maîtrise rédactionnelle en français, sens du storytelling produit 

→  Bonne compréhension des logiques de cross-sell et de merchandising produit 

→  Anglais professionnel indispensable (échanges réguliers avec les équipes groupe) 

→  Solides bases en SEO (recherche de mots-clés, bonnes pratiques on-page) 

→  Orienté(e) résultats : chaque action doit être mesurée et évaluée à l'aune de son impact sur la performance 

Compétences comportementales 

→  Rigueur, sens du détail et respect des délais de production 

→  Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main rapidement un nouvel outil (Magento) 

→  Aisance dans le travail transverse (E-Merchandising Manager, SEO, CRO) 

→  Curiosité pour les enjeux e-commerce et data 


Avantages chez Lovehoney Group France

  • Fruits disponibles chaque semaine
  • Petit-déjeuner chaque premier lundi du mois
  • OpenUp : plateforme gratuite dédiée au bien-être et à la santé mentale
  • Salle de jeux avec baby-foot, tennis de table et fléchettes
  • Flexibilité concernant les horaires de travail et les congés payés

title: Sales Engineer Enterprise - FR
description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The Sales Engineer drives revenue growth in the FR region while serving as the critical link between market needs, product strategy, and sales team effectiveness. This role balances three core missions: closing new business (primary focus), establishing a product feedback loop, and validating the setup for implementation with integrators.

Your Impact at Brevo:

Execute comprehensive deal handoffs to onboarding teams with detailed technical documentation.

Track and quantify MRR lost due to product limitations or missing features. Participate in regular product feedback sessions with Product Management, providing competitive intelligence, market trend analysis, and feature request prioritization based on revenue impact
  • Product Enablement: Collaborate with the Sales Engineer team to maintain expert-level knowledge of Brevo's products and actively contribute to the team's technical expertise.   • Understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth/API keys/JWT, and web protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, DNS). CDP experience is a plus.
  • AI enthusiast : proven use of AI skills, agents, illustrate productivity gain with AI, being able to create custom agents to solve recurring pain points. MCP knwoledge is a plus.
  • Proven track record partnering with AEs, supporting multiple reps, and driving high win rates.
  • Experience collaborating with Product to translate market needs, quantify revenue impact, and guide competitive positioning.
  • Experience with integrator partners is a big plus.
  • Excellent communicator able to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Analytical, highly organized and self-motivated.
  • Native french speaker; business fluent in English
  • Engineering or business degree with strong technical aptitude (Plus).

    • Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together : Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.

title: Stockiste (H/F) - Aix en Provence - CDI
description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Sézane est un terrain de jeu où chaque journée ne ressemble à aucune autre, votre poste d’aujourd’hui ne sera peut-être plus celui d’hier et probablement pas celui de demain. Ça vous parle ? Écrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Stockiste (H/F) en 35H pour rejoindre nos équipes retail à partir du mois de Novembre 2026 en CDI.
Ce poste est basé à Aix en Provence (13).


Rattaché(e) au Directeur de l’Appartement vos principales responsabilités seront : 

Garantir une gestion efficace du stock 

En Appartement  :

  • Garantir la bonne réception des livraisons (déballages, tri, étiquetage, bipage, rangement) ;
  • Enregistrer les livraisons en suivant les processus ;
  • Effectuer le réassort quotidien de la boutique dans le respect des standards de merchandising ;
  • Assurer la bonne tenue de la réserve en garantissant un rangement rigoureux et optimal ;
  • Suivre le bon déroulement des procédures de transferts entre les boutiques ;
  • Participer aux inventaires (volants, mensuels, fiscaux) de la boutique ;
  • Répondre aux besoins de l'équipe de vente en lui apportant les pièces demandées par les clients sur le floor.

En Conciergerie :

  • Assurer la bonne gestion des SAV (traitement et remboursement) ;
  • Veiller à l’envoi des colis en réparation ;
  • Intégrer, scanner et ranger le Click & Collect ;
  • Vérifier les commandes Click & Collect en attente (remboursement, renvoi, relance client).

Délivrer une expérience client singulière

  • Avoir une connaissance parfaite du stock afin de répondre aux attentes des Clients le plus efficacement possible ;
  • Fluidifier la liaison entre le stock et la surface de vente par une organisation structurée ;
  • Veiller à présenter un produit selon les standards Octane ;
  • Etre ambassadeur de l'omnicanalité de la Marque (appartement et web) ;
  • Faire preuve de curiosité et développer une connaissance approfondie de la Marque et des produits ;
  • Connaître notre politique RSE pour répondre aux clients.

Garantir l’image de marque

  • Participer à la bonne présentation des produits en mettant en avant les nouveautés ;
  • Aider le Visuel Merchandiser ou le Relai Visuel Merchandiser à la préparation de la nouvelle implantation ;
  • Vérifier le rangement et l'étiquetage des produits en réserve ;
  • Assurer la qualité des produits par un rangement minutieux ;
  • Proposer des ajustements merchandising afin d’optimiser la rotation des produits en stock ;
  • Assurer l'approvisionnement quotidiens de l'Appartement et le parfait rangement des réserves.

Avoir un esprit d’équipe

  • Etre Team-player, participer à toutes les tâches annexes ;
  • Participer à la création d’un environnement positif et harmonieux pour créer une synergie de groupe ;
  • Relayer les engagements de la marque ;
  • Avoir un esprit d’équipe, d’entraide pour favoriser la synergie de groupe et la cohésion.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes autonome et réactif, pour optimiser le rangement du réassort et des nouveautés ;
    Soigneux et appliqué, vous manipulez les produits avec le plus grand soin ;
  • Vous comprenez les enjeux du Retail et n’hésitez pas à vous adapter rapidement et efficacement ;

description:
Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months

  • Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

  • Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

  • Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 Your mission

  • Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

  • Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

  • Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

  • Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

  • Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

  • Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

  • Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

  • Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 How you will be measured

  • First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

  • 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

  • 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 This job is your dream job if:

  • You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

  • You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

  • You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

  • You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

  • You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 This job is not for you if:

  • You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

  • You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

  • You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

  • Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off

  • You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group

What we offer

  • A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa

  • Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE

  • Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea

🧭 Our recruitment process

  1. A first call to get to know each other.

  2. A deep dive into two deals you closed.

  3. A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders.

  4. A conversation with the founders.

  5. Reference checks, with your consent.

  6. Offer.

We answer after each step.

title: AI Content Manager Intern
description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The internship

You'll shape how Homa communicates, inside and out. You'll operate at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and AI, turning complex ideas into sharp content that lands with every audience: talent, game studios, partners, investors, and our own teams. There's no shadow work. What you create will be published, presented, and read. You'll develop a 360° understanding of Homa by working with every function, while building your writing, design, and AI skills.

What you'll do

  • Build. Design AI-powered content systems (workflows, prompt libraries, templates) so the team can produce more, faster, without losing quality.
  • Create. Produce high-impact content fast: LinkedIn posts, blog articles, employer branding, internal decks, and strategic presentations.
  • Produce. Use AI tools for images, video, and copy to create high-performing creatives and content for our games.
  • Monitor trends. Track social media trends, competitor content, and new AI tools to stay ahead.
  • Elevate. Spot high-impact opportunities, introduce better formats and tools, and raise the bar for how Homa informs, inspires, and engages.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
  • Real ownership, early. Your projects will change how Homa operates, and you'll see the results.
  • Learn from leadership. You'll work alongside leaders and people who make decisions.
  • A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
  • AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.

Requirements

  • Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes, when something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
  • Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this internship as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
  • Bonus: you've built something. A game, an app, a student initiative, a side business. We'd love to hear about it.

For this role, you'll also bring:

  • You've created content in some form: a blog, a TikTok page, a newsletter, a portfolio, a standout university project. Show us. We care about what you've made, not where you made it.
  • Sharp writing. You write and speak with clarity and punch, adapt to any audience, and work confidently with anyone.
  • Design instinct. You're fluent in content tools (slides, Canva, Figma, or similar) and build clean, high-quality visuals.

Practical details

  • A 6-month internship, with a flexible start date. We adapt to any month.
  • A convention de stage (internship agreement) is required.
  • Apprenticeships (alternance) are also welcome.
  • Paris based. You'll need to be able to work onsite at our Paris office.
  • Fluent English is required. French is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Top performers may be offered a full-time role at the end of the internship

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

title: Process Engineer - Semiconductor Processes
description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. 
  • Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
  • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
  • Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
  • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 

R&D to Production Transfer 

  • Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
  • Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
  • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
  • Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
  • Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
  • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement 

  • Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
  • Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
  • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
  • Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
  • Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 

Equipment & Production Support 

  • Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
  • Support equipment qualification, troubleshooting and process recovery following equipment interventions. 
  • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 

Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

  • Characterize the impact of fabrication parameters on material and device performance. 
  • Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
  • Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
  • Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
  • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 

Documentation & Communication 

  • Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
  • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
  • Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Strong knowledge of dry etching, ideally including hands-on experience with ICP-RIE. 
  • Experience with one or more complementary processes such as RIE, PECVD, physical vapor deposition / metal evaporation and lithography. 
  • Strong understanding of how fabrication parameters can influence material properties and device performance. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience with optical and electrical characterization of semiconductor or optoelectronic devices. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 
  • Knowledge of Python or other programming languages for process-data analysis, automated reporting, instrument control or experimental automation. 

Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new processes where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams. 

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

    • Hiring Manager Interview (45')

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for the engineer who will lead it.

As Engineering Manager for the Lini AI Platform, you will report directly to the Head of Engineering and lead a squad yet to be hired, fully focused on Lini initiatives. You will own both the technical quality and the human dimension of the team, from architecture decisions to individual growth plans.

A key part of the role is coordination: you sit at the intersection of ML, product, and feature engineering, and you are accountable for making those conversations productive.

We are looking for a senior engineer who grew into leadership and kept writing code (~30% of your time), while driving delivery, standards, and culture.

We also care about how you think about AI: whether you approach it as a design question as much as an engineering one, and whether you bring genuine curiosity and opinions into product conversations.

Missions :

  • Work in close collaboration with the ML team, Product Managers, and feature squads to define and ship Lini features
  • Translate model capabilities into product requirements, negotiate scope across teams, and clear cross-team dependencies before they become blockers
  • Lead code reviews, own the squad's engineering standards, and weigh in on architecture choices
  • Own delivery end-to-end: from scoping and planning to deployment and iteration, across all Lini-powered features in the DiliTrust Suite
  • Define and evolve the integration architecture of Lini across modules, including LLM connectors and context management
  • Partner with the Head of Engineering on cross-squad initiatives, technical roadmap, and hiring
  • Run regular 1:1s, provide structured feedback, and support each engineer's career development
  • Set and maintain engineering best practices: testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability

Requirements

Experience & seniority :
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • 3+ years managing an engineering team or squad in a product-oriented environment
  • Proven track record of owning technical decisions: architecture, scalability, code quality (not just managing the people making them)
  • Background at the intersection of AI or ML and product engineering: you know what it takes to go from a model capability to a production user experience
  • Proven ability to coordinate across multiple teams simultaneously (ML, product, engineering)
  • Fluent in French and English
Technical expertise :
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js / TypeScript and Vue.js 3
  • Deep background in scalable web architectures and API design
  • Solid experience with LLM integration patterns in production (RAG, streaming, tool use, context management)
  • Comfortable with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices in production
Leadership & collaboration :
  • Strong sense of ownership
  • Ability to build trust, create accountability, and grow engineers into senior roles
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You see AI as a design question as much as an integration challenge, and bring that thinking into product conversations
  • You engage with the product, bring ideas to the table, and consider yourself a stakeholder in the solutions your squad ships

Our Tech Stack

Backend: Node.js / TypeScript / Symfony
Frontend: Vue.js 3
AI/ML layer:  Python, internal models, LLM connectors
Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 

What we offer :

Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment (offices in France, Italy, Spain, Canada, Germany, USA, Mexico, Dubai...);
Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process :

    1. Interview with TA team member (30/45 mins)
    2. Interview with the Head of Engineering (1h)
    3. Technical interview (1h30 mins)
    4. Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

  • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


Process

  1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

  2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

  3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

  4. Meet the team in the office.

  5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

How to Apply

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.


What you'll do

Architecture

  • Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

  • Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

  • Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

  • Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

  • Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

    • Configuration & tooling

  • Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

  • Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

  • Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure


    • What we're looking for

    Required

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)

  • Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting

  • Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case

  • High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production

  • Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.

  • Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures

  • Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases

  • You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software

  • You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with

  • You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope

  • You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call

description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

  • Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

  • Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

  • Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

  • English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.

We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.

This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.

What You Will Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.

  • Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.

  • Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.

  • Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.

  • Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.

  • Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.

  • A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.

  • Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.

  • Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.

  • Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market.
